decisions.decision: Defer the unmet Phase 6 Exit 4 obligation until before Phase 10 beta acceptance.
decisions.authority:
I approve a Level 3 deferral of Phase 6 Exit 4—“Editing resource use improves beyond normal noise, with complete end-to-end cost accounted for”—for its existing bounded Entry/Exit scope, to a mandatory acceptance condition before the Phase 10 beta gate.

Record four accepted exits and one deferred, unmet obligation. Do not report 5/5 acceptance. Permit only the necessary sequencing exception for separately authorised later Core development. Preserve normal per-slice checks, comparison paths and all retirement conditions.

I accept the bounded sequencing exposure. I remain accountable for delivery through a named Phase 10 integration owner and for acceptance after independent review. Numerical budgets or improvement on another workload cannot discharge this obligation. If it remains unmet, beta acceptance is blocked.
decisions.exclusions: Preserve measurement rules, retained negative evidence and stopped directions. Authorise only the directly dependent Level 3 repository alignment. This decision accepts no performance result, closes no phase, opens no subsequent phase, authorises no product implementation or legacy removal, and changes no output or release status.

decisions.authority:
As project owner, I accept Phase 9A closeout at 4/4 for the frozen reference-only scope, subject to the existing closeout conditions.

Complete the required Level 3 alignment and publish an exact-green draft PR.

decisions.decision:
Accept the Phase 9B Core Generate export policy. Each export uses a different new directory. One directory operation makes the full output set available. CSV stays optional. Output paths change. All previous output stays unchanged.

Authorise the necessary Level 3 alignment and bounded implementation.
decisions.authority:
As project owner, I approve the proposed Phase 9B Core Generate export policy: unique collision-free folders, atomic whole-set publication, optional CSV, revised output paths and preservation of all previously published outputs.

Authorise the necessary Level 3 alignment and bounded implementation.

Qualify atomic publication without claiming durability or restart recovery. Preserve all other export and acceptance boundaries.
decisions.exclusions:
Qualify only the full output set that becomes available through one directory operation in the tested host. The operator must control the output directory. Claim no assurance that files stay available after a system interruption. Claim no recovery after FreeCAD stops and starts again. Claim no assurance for every filesystem or for changes that another process makes to the directory during this operation. Preserve member filenames and content requirements except the authorised final-path change. Keep CSV optional. Preserve the Phase 7 comparison and staging APIs, selected-export route, and D-P6-003/D-P6-004 Entry/Exit authority.

Accept no phase exit or closeout. Phase 9B stays Open at 1/6 under D-P9-012, with only Exit 9B-2 Evidenced and owner-accepted. The other five exits stay Pending.

Phase 9A stays closed at 4/4 for its frozen reference-only scope. Preserve all six exact criteria, geometry, package bytes, numerical limits, the 113-entry register, all 24 risk duties and legacy-retirement conditions. D-P6-008 stays Deferred — unmet.

TERM-R04 stays open. Output stays private-development and project status stays unknown. Accept no physical fit, preload, retention, manufacturing capability, production package, output clearance, rights, performance result or release.

Complete one bounded implementation with usual validation, independent review and the finite documentation lifecycle. Publish an exact-green draft PR. Do not merge or start another outcome.

decisions.decision: Permit Codex to decide and perform permanent removal of completed local worktrees and specified obsolete local branches as Level 2 under the Recovery-owned conditions. The authority applies only after the accepted amendment is integrated into protected main. Creating or expanding this authority remains Level 3.
decisions.authority:
Integrate pr 166, then switch to a small bit of housekeeping.

Chatgpt pro reviewed the git estate and the failing worktree and branch removal see attached md file for reccomendations. Review file then implement. I agree all level 3 changes in advance to improve efficiency of this repair.

Adopted owner addendum:

As project owner, I authorise the bounded Level 3 governance change needed to make eligible post-merge worktree and local branch retirement a Level 2 decision delegated to Codex.

Once accepted and integrated, Codex may decide and perform permanent deletion of eligible completed local worktrees and obsolete local branches, without my approval for each target. Preserve existing identity, containment, inactivity, inventory, preservation, audit and independent-review requirements. Retain active, unique, ambiguous or insufficiently preserved material.

Reconcile the canonical classification and Continue exclusions, connect retirement to the post-merge workflow, and update dependent checks. Remote branch deletion and force removal are excluded.

Publish one independently reviewed draft PR with the required diff and preservation evidence. Do not merge or exercise the new retirement authority during this task.
decisions.exclusions:
Preserve exact identity, accepted-history containment, inactivity, complete local-state inventory, independent snapshot and restore proof, preservation, audit, independent review and post-removal checks. Missing or failed evidence retains the target. Protect primary main and active, unique, ambiguous or insufficiently preserved state.

Continue assesses only the previous PR's observed local candidate after clean main synchronisation and repeated IDE alignment. Recheck identity before action. Record retired, retained with reason, absent/already retired or assessment unavailable. Do not sweep unrelated worktrees or branches.

Permit only ordinary git worktree remove and the specified contained git branch -d after worktree removal. Preserve targets after ordinary Git refusal. Exclude remote branch deletion, force removal, tag deletion, history rewrite, prune, stash and manual recursive deletion. D-GOV-022 is not available through this delegation. Preserve all frozen decisions and their limits.

This Level 3 alignment publishes one independently reviewed exact-green draft PR only. Do not merge the new draft or exercise the new retirement authority during this task.

Phase 9A stays closed at 4/4 for its frozen reference-only scope. Phase 9B stays Open at 1/6, with five exits Pending. Preserve the 113-entry register, geometry, all 24 risk duties, D-P6-008 Deferred — unmet, TERM-R04 open, private-development output and project status unknown. Accept no production, rights, performance, release or phase result.
